servinfo.title: Boost Pressure Sensor with IAT Sensor-2 Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Disconnect boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2 connector.
Remove boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2 (1) from intercooler outlet pipe.

servinfosub.title: Installation

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Boost Pressure Sensor with IAT Sensor-2 Inspection:K14D

servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following point.

item.ptxt: Check O-ring of boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2 for deformation or damage.
If defect is found, replace boost pressure sensor with IAT sensor-2.
